name: WhiteDB
listed_description: Lightweight database library, operating entirely in main memory. (claim words: None; licence tag: GPL-3.0-or-later; https://github.com/oz123/awesome-c#Database)
reason: No numeric comparison against any named baseline in README, Doc/Manual.txt, Doc/Tutorial.txt, Examples/speed/*.c (absolute timings only, e.g. 10 million 5-field records created in 0.586 s, no other database timed), or issues. Issue #1 (comparison with Redis, MongoDB, Tokyo Cabinet, Neo4j) gets a maintainer reply that WhiteDB is faster for most operations because there is no client/server round trip, with no measurements; he declines to write benchmarks. A 2013 Hacker News thread (news.ycombinator.com/item?id=6612379) has an anecdote that WhiteDB beat Redis on a simple associative map, no numbers. The project's whitedb.org/speed.html page (referenced by Examples/speed/README) does not resolve from this environment (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND), so its content could not be checked. Repo archived 2026-06-02. Directional claim only, so no record.
